custom.label: Shot variety
custom.instruction: Flag three or more consecutive panels using the same framing (all wide, all close). A sequence that never changes distance reads as a slideshow.

custom.label: Caption length
custom.instruction: A panel caption is a direction, not a paragraph. Flag any caption over twenty-five words or carrying more than one action.

custom.label: Panel covers its beat
custom.instruction: Every beat in the plan must appear in at least one panel, and every panel must belong to a beat. Flag a beat with no panel and a panel that illustrates nothing in the plan.
